note: Authoring records implemented by the cited code adapters; not a generic plan loader. Current colour/shared-study evidence is recorded in verification-color-study.json; verification.json preserves the earlier presentation review.
reveal: One new name at a time, retaining previous names in the same scene; fade the group together at the scene exit. No names carry into the next scene.
placement: Name beside actual projected mesh silhouette; 15px mobile / 20px desktop clearance. Short line to a real surface vertex. No fixed screen-edge anchors or arrowheads.
layout: Measure once per chapter/viewport in the fixed base camera, reserve other links chapter sweeps and earlier names. Reproject the cached anchor during the authored pullback without changing side, font size or leader length. Hide if no clear placement fits, during manual orbit or before the incoming camera settles.
paused: Retained names in the current scene are readable; future names and prior scenes remain hidden.
camera: Only the stationary wrist/grip detail scenes pull back after reading. All named targets have settled for the remainder of their scene.
